description.value:
You set out to be a famous Starfinder, and to cash in that fame for your own financial benefit. You aim to acquire multiple corporate sponsorships and brand deals, but for now, you're working on seizing every opportunity to be in the spotlight and soaking up the attention.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Media Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Just Kidding]{Just Kidding!} skill feat.
